outcome: maternal complications (adhesions, uterine rupture, bladder injury, endometritis, wound infection)
cohort: 165 women who underwent multiple repeat CSs at Zagazig University Hospital.
finding: While the likelihood of maternal complications increases with the number of CSs, infant outcome is more influenced by mode and time of delivery, with 4 or more CSs being a significant threshold for most outcomes.
